outcome: HIV detection rate in pregnant women
Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean) among HIV-positive women
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a reduced HIV detection rate among pregnant women, decreased antiretroviral use during childbirth, and changes in mode of delivery.
mod_finding: There was a 55% reduction in vaginal births and a 39% reduction in cesarean sections among women diagnosed with HIV after the start of the COVID-19 pandemic.
